mapper.insert: INSERT INTO checkin (appointment_id, patient_id, department_id, doctor_id, checkin_time, queue_status, call_time, call_count, rejoin_time, consult_room, create_time) VALUES (#{appointmentId}, #{patientId}, #{departmentId}, #{doctorId}, #{checkinTime}, #{queueStatus}, #{callTime}, #{callCount}, #{rejoinTime}, #{consultRoom}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM checkin WHERE patient_id = #{patientId} ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM checkin WHERE department_id = #{departmentId} AND queue_status = 'WAITING' ORDER BY checkin_time ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE checkin SET queue_status = #{queueStatus}, rejoin_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
